limitations: Lineup export contains 2,000 units; coverage may be capped. Absent combinations are unavailable, not zero.
Coordinates use NBA legacy tenths of feet. Zones are our geometric approximation.
All observations are 2024–25 regular season. No defender tracking is available.
Zone reference points use descriptive league averages; run shot_model.py for held-out model-based expected points.

shot_model.target: Made field goal conditional on an attempted shot
limitations: Conditional shot conversion estimate, not a forecast of where a player will shoot.
No defender locations, shot-clock time, player identity, or injury information. Period clock is not shot clock.
No causal claim about changing shot selection. No calibrated individual shot uncertainty interval.
Single held-out season; probability calibration may vary by player and context.
